The Mistral adapter now handles tool calls cut off by the token limit without parsing incomplete arguments. It emits the raw arguments without `input` and preserves the `length` finish reason. Tests cover `length`, `tool_calls`, `stop`, and malformed arguments.| |**End-to-end route and verification**
`testing/e2e/src/routes/api.mistral-truncated-tool-call.ts`, `testing/e2e/src/routeTree.gen.ts`, `testing/e2e/tests/mistral-truncated-tool-call.spec.ts`|The new route collects Mistral run results and finish reasons.
